messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: blavaan 0.3-12 is released
parts:
blavaan 0.3-12 is now on CRAN. It fixes a number of bugs, with some new functionality for the wiggle.sd argument and for sampling from the prior. The default priors have also been tweaked for improved sampling efficiency. Further input about default priors is welcome.

Some further detail is at: http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee/blavaan/version.html
